4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: Lucian held the door for me and we both left the office for the White Room.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: One by one, my ministers packed up and left the White Room.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: The last two and a half years had gone by so fast.

96.speaker: Narrator
96.text: I stared at the secret phone in my office and thought about what Remus Holstron had told me.

97.speaker: Narrator
97.text: I wasn't sure if using Karl to go against the Old Guard was a sound choice. I wondered if he could be trusted.

98.speaker: Narrator
98.text: Maybe this was the time to take advantage of my cooperation with the Young Sords.
98.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_AttemptToKillOrsoHawker"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_Kill_OrsoHawker"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.YoungSords_Kill_OrsoHawker"] == true) == false)

104.speaker: Narrator
104.text: Maybe this was the time to take advantage of my cooperation with the Young Sords again.
104.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_AttemptToKillOrsoHawker"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_Kill_OrsoHawker"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.YoungSords_Kill_OrsoHawker"] == true)

117.speaker: Narrator
117.text: I left the White Room and headed to my office.

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: I followed suit and headed to my office.

132.speaker: Gus Manger
132.text: “In a few years the vineyard may even challenge its regional rivals. But it would need some further attention to rank among Sordland's best.”

139.speaker: Gus Manger
139.text: “FC Anrica has seen a boost in ticket sales following your endorsement and participation in the club. The management decided to send over a slice of that pie.”

140.speaker: Gus Manger
140.text: “The management of Underhall has decided to send big bonuses to the board after high revenue growth this quarter.”

141.speaker: Gus Manger
141.text: “Several construction projects have been accomplished around the country. The company coffers are full and we stand to benefit.”

143.speaker: Gus Manger
143.text: “Your vineyard in Erlory has begun producing some wine. I have also arranged for several tasting sessions in order to sample the product and give ideas on how to improve the quality.”

146.speaker: Gus Manger
146.text: “The manager personally thanked you for the support you have shown the team. Several players have already decided to join the USP.”

147.speaker: Gus Manger
147.text: “Since its successful contract win, the company has received and accepted numerous several mega-projects in other countries. Underhall's future is looking bright.”

151.speaker: Gus Manger
151.text: "Mr. President. Just a quick word regarding the investment I arranged for you."

152.speaker: Gus Manger
152.text: “The money should be arriving in your account shortly.”

156.speaker: Gus Manger
156.text: “The manager personally thanked you for the support you have shown and wanted me to relay that he is no fan of Mayor Leste either.”

159.speaker: Gus Manger
159.text: "What did I tell you, Mr. President? Take a little risk and it'll pay off in the end."

160.speaker: Player
160.text: "So awarding Underhall a government contract caused me to benefit personally. That doesn't sound entirely above-board."

162.speaker: Gus Manger
162.text: "Don't worry. Nobody else needs to know about this."

163.speaker: Player
163.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn02_InT_Corporation_UnderhallConstruction"] == true   and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn05_P_Underhall"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn05_P_FCAnrica"] == true)

164.speaker: Gus Manger
164.text: "FC Anrica? Actually, they've been playing a lot better than in recent years. You should check out a match sometime."

169.speaker: Gus Manger
169.text: "It's a pleasure doing business with you. And Ewald sends his greetings."

170.speaker: Gus Manger
170.text: "And they're happy to receive that support. Truly a two-way street."

171.speaker: Gus Manger
171.text: "It's a pleasure doing business with you."

172.speaker: Gus Manger
172.text: "I look forward to opening the first bottle with you."

173.speaker: Player
173.text: "I'm just happy to support Sordish businesses."
